declared_exclusion_before_execution.rule: a short-answer item whose gold answer folds to <= 2 characters is excluded
declared_exclusion_before_execution.why: such a gold is contained in almost any returned string, so the item auto-passes both branches under the containment rule and would enter as evidence that the figure was unnecessary. That is a generation defect read as a measurement.

branches.TEXT: the chunk's scoped evidence text plus the question. No image, no figure description, no declared quotation, no rationale.
branches.TEXT_IMG: the same text, the same question, plus the chunk's own figure crops

design.identical_between_branches: prompt text, response schema, decoding settings. Only the image content blocks differ.
design.why_the_control_branch_is_required: without TEXT_IMG a wrong answer under TEXT is ambiguous between 'the item needs the figure' and 'the item is unanswerable'
design.why_the_generator_answers_its_own_items: it is the census generator, so the measurement is on the same model whose output was gated; a different answerer would confound answerer capability with figure dependence. Same choice as the sealed frame-C and frame-D ablations, retained for comparability.

grading.multiple_choice: correct iff the returned option_index equals the recorded correct_option; no string heuristic, chance level 0.25
grading.primary_rule: symmetric word-F1 over accent- and case-folded content tokens; an answer is correct iff F1(returned, gold) >= 0.70
grading.secondary_rule_reported_beside_it: containment in either direction, the frame-D primary, reported for comparability only and carrying no claim here

why_the_rule_changed.consequence_for_the_published_frame_d_nu: the frame-D ablation reported V*=0.4261 and exact McNemar p=0.0386 as evidence that figures were measurably necessary. Re-graded under symmetric word-F1 at eight thresholds from 0.50 to 0.90, NO threshold reproduces significance. That result is therefore a grading artefact and is corrected on the record here rather than left standing.
why_the_rule_changed.defect: containment is lenient on substrings but STRICT on insertions: one inserted function word scores an otherwise identical answer wrong
why_the_rule_changed.why_0.70_and_not_the_threshold_with_the_: 0.70 is the knee where a single inserted or dropped function word no longer flips a verdict, and it is chosen for that structural reason. Choosing the threshold with the smallest p-value would be the same defect in the opposite direction; all eight thresholds are reported as a sensitivity curve whatever the primary shows.

items.population: every generation that passed the v1 gate in round4_framef_census_20260830T140000Z, across all five arms

power.honest_limit: the within-arm tables are small: outside ECM-v2 no arm has more than 11 A2-pass items, so within-arm comparisons are descriptive and carry no significance claim. Only the pooled table is powered, and only the pooled table carries the confound above.

pre_committed_reporting: If A2-admitted items are more figure-dependent than A2-rejected ones, A2 has construct validity as a multimodality gate and the Frame-F result reads as intended.

If they are not, A2 is reported as a compliance gate: it measures whether the generator followed the division-of-labour instruction, not whether the resulting item needs the figure. The Frame-F contrasts stand as measured and their INTERPRETATION narrows.
If the pooled table separates but the within-arm tables do not, the result is reported as confounded with arm and not as gate validity.
The frame-D ablation's published V*=0.4261 / p=0.0386 is corrected on the record as a grading artefact, whatever this ablation shows.
No outcome licenses changing the gates, the frame, the census, or regenerating items.

primary_endpoint.confound_declared_now: A2 status correlates with arm by construction: ECM-v2 supplies 24 of the 57 A2-pass items. The pooled test therefore cannot separate 'A2 selects figure-dependent items' from 'the ECM-v2 arm writes figure-dependent items'. Both readings are reported, and the WITHIN-ARM version of the same table is reported for every arm with enough items, which is the form that breaks the confound.
primary_endpoint.definition: V*(i) = 1 - R_TEXT(i) is 1 when item i is NOT answerable from text alone. The endpoint is the difference in V* between the items A2 admitted and the items A2 rejected.
primary_endpoint.direction_not_assumed: two-sided. A2-admitted items being LESS figure-dependent is a valid and reportable outcome, and would mean the gates select against the property they were built for.
primary_endpoint.name: A2 construct validity
primary_endpoint.test: Fisher exact two-sided on the 2x2 table of A2 status against V*, over all scored items pooled across arms
primary_endpoint.why_unpaired: A2 status is a property of an item, not a condition applied to a chunk, so A2-pass and A2-fail items are different items and the comparison is unpaired. The paired quantity is reported separately as the branch contrast below.

document.question_this_answers: Frame F showed ECM-v2 raises A2 against every control. A2 is built from three gates that are PROXIES for multimodality: G6 is a structural relation between two returned fields, and G7/G8 are OCR-overlap tests with measured chance rates far above zero. This ablation asks whether the items A2 admits actually need the figure. If they do not, A2 measures prompt compliance rather than multimodality, and the Frame-F result must be restated as such.

pre_committed_reporting: If ECM-v2 separates from ecm_full on A2, the claim becomes: making the division of labour a checked condition rather than a requested property is what produces multimodal items, on this corpus.

If ECM-v2 separates from the baselines but NOT from its length-matched disclosure control, the honest claim is that stating the conditions suffices and fixing the construction order adds nothing measurable. That is weaker and it is what gets written.

If ECM-v2 does not separate at all, the reported contribution of the method narrows to the provenance result that reproduced across frames C, D and E, and the paper says the multimodal claim was not established on this corpus.
If A2 is near zero in every arm, that is reported as the corpus being unable to support figure-answered items at this granularity, with the per-gate rates showing which condition was binding.
Any result that rests on G7/G8 rather than G6 is reported with the chance baselines beside it.
No outcome licenses relaxing a v1 gate, changing rule 4, or regenerating items.

document.question_this_answers: The reported ablation was answered by the census generator itself (qwen3-vl-8b-instruct), so every V* value admits two readings: the information genuinely is not in the text channel, or this one model happened to recover (or fail to recover) its own intent for reasons unrelated to the text. The direction of that bias cannot be settled by argument: a generator may find its own answer easier to reconstruct (inflating R_txt, deflating V*), or it may have deliberately placed the answer in the figure and therefore never read the prose (deflating R_txt, inflating V*). This record measures it with an answerer from a fourth model family.

per-answerer agreement: the item-level concordance between the two answerers on R_text, which bounds how much of V* is answerer-specific

pilot_records_removed.why: the ledger permits a re-run because provider is part of the idempotency key, but the task and claim files are keyed on task_id alone. Leaving them would make those 2 cells count as already done, so the census would silently grade 225 of 227 items and lose one item in both branches.

document.what_a_reader_should_conclude: this run measures the construct-validity endpoint with an independent answerer, as pre-registered. It does so over a different transport than the pre-registration named, because that transport silently dropped the response schema the pre-registration also required. A reader who regards the route as part of the frozen design should treat this record as a declared deviation rather than a clean prospective execution.
document.what_changed: the egress route for the secondary answerer moves from the local omniproxy gateway to OpenRouter
what_did_not_change: the answerer model is unchanged: gemini-3.5-flash (google/gemini-3.5-flash on OpenRouter)
the item population, payload builder, image integrity check and grading rule are still imported from the sealed runner, not reimplemented
temperature 0, zero retry, no fallback, per-item pairing, both branches, image bytes with hash re-verification
the call cap of 454 and the frozen pre-registration sha256

why.observed_consequence: in the 2-call pilot both calls returned HTTP 200 with finish_reason=stop and were recorded TERMINAL_FAILURE/UNDECODABLE. The text_only call returned the right shape wrapped in a markdown fence; the text_image call returned an entirely different object (tinh_huong_1 -> van_de_phap_ly: [...]) for a multiple-choice item. Under an enforced schema with additionalProperties:false and strict:true that response cannot occur.
why.primary_reason: the pre-registration asserts two things that cannot both hold on the omniproxy chat path: answerer.route = 'omniproxy, local gateway', and everything_else_identical including 'response schema'. On that path response_format is absent from the entire request-translation chain, so the json_schema constraint never reaches the upstream model.
why.secondary_reason_route_stability: across today's probes the omniproxy route failed 3/3 attempts for this model with 'VSLLM: http2 timeout awaiting response headers' and once with 'No available accounts'. The runner uses max_retries=0 and retry_reserve=0, and the ledger counts a CALL_STARTED as a spent cap token, so each timeout would permanently burn one cell of the 454.
why.why_not_a_different_family_instead: the pre-registration's list of conditions that would invalidate this record has, as item 1, 'changing the answerer model after the first call'. The first calls occurred at 12:28Z. Changing route is not on that list; changing the model is. gemini-3.5-flash already satisfies the independence requirement: it is not the generator family (Qwen) and not either judge family (Anthropic, OpenAI).
why.why_the_schema_is_the_field_that_must_be: it defines the endpoint's response space, it is the precondition for importing the sealed runner's grading instead of writing a second parser, and it governs the text_image branch that carries the entire figure-dependence claim. The route is transport.

redaction_rule: any string carrying Vietnamese diacritics is replaced, because on this corpus such strings are source-derived or private conversation; the fields removed are listed
what: the frozen pre-registrations, the declared route deviation, and the execution authorisations. Each carries the sha256 of the sealed file so a reviewer can bind a claim to the frozen text.
